Data Exposure Report France Telecommunications Customer & Billing Data Leak Claim Unverified

Geofixe Data Leak Claim Lists 1,656 Records With Customer, Billing and Payment Information

Claimed lines1,656
Emails130
Phones56
Claimed size328 MB
Severity HIGH

Overview

An actor using the handle "ChimeraZ" claims to have leaked a database associated with Geofixe, a French telecommunications service that provides virtual landline numbers.

The listing advertises 1,656 lines in a 328 MB CSV dataset, with 130 email addresses and 56 phone numbers. The visible files include cards.csv, charges.csv, invoices.csv and people.csv, with samples showing customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, billing addresses, card-related fields, charge records and invoice/payment data. The dataset, its source, the stated counts and current availability have not been independently verified.

Mapped techniques

Claimed identifies behavior explicitly described by the actor. Inferred identifies an analytical mapping supported by the supplied material. Neither label means the activity has been independently verified.

  • Collection T1213.006 Data from Information Repositories: Databases Inferred The listing presents structured CSV datasets containing people, card, charge and invoice information. The supplied material does not disclose how the data was obtained or independently establish unauthorized access to Geofixe systems.

Potential impact

If authentic, the claimed dataset could expose customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, billing records, card-related information and invoice/payment metadata. That combination could support targeted phishing, identity fraud, payment fraud, impersonation or other customer-focused abuse.

Status Unverified

Dark Web Informer has not independently verified the dataset's authenticity, source, completeness, 1,656-line count, email or phone totals, 328 MB size, sample contents or current availability. The supplied screenshot documents the listing and visible samples, not independent confirmation of the underlying data.
